_howto: Add one object to items for each game, project or class material. Only title, type and course are required. type is game, project or material. thumbnail is a path in this folder (showcase/...) or an https image URL. play opens inside the site (a showcase/ folder with an index.html, or an https embed URL from itch.io or Scratch). link opens in a new tab. Delete the sample entries (sample: true) when you add real ones. Use first names or team names only, never full names or photos of students.

items.title: Chatty Arcade
items.description: Walk an arcade hall where every cabinet is a course. Play its mini-game, earn a cartridge and build your own course route. About a 40 MB first load, and it plays best on a computer with a keyboard. Sound starts after your first click.

items.title: Escape Prison
items.description: A choose-your-own-adventure in HTML and CSS. You've been locked up for a crime you didn't commit, and every choice is a step toward breaking out and clearing your name.

items.title: Shining Eye's Fall
items.description: A courtroom mystery inspired by Ace Attorney. Gather evidence at the crime scenes, then pick what to show the jury. Some pieces change how the trial ends.

items.title: Dead Resort
items.description: A spooky choose-your-path story set at a tropical resort that is not as relaxing as the brochure promised.

items.title: A Brand New Minecraft World
items.description: A Minecraft fan adventure in HTML and CSS. You spawn into a fresh world and choose how your first day goes: hunt, punch trees, go caving or just wander.

items.title: Packet Dodge
items.description: Demo slot: a tiny browser game that shows how a student's HTML5 export plays right on this page. Replace it with a real game jam build.

items.title: Your Construct 3 game here
items.description: Export from Construct 3 as Web (HTML5), drop the folder into showcase/, and point play at its index.html.

items.title: Your Coding 2 engine build here
items.description: Godot and Unity can export to the web, or link out to an itch.io page. Either way it lands here as one card.

items.title: CyberPatriot field guide
items.description: The team's searchable reference for Windows, Windows Server and Linux images. Add the guide's link to make this card live.

items.title: AI student investigation
items.description: Space for a finished student investigation, tested chatbot or field guide from the AI course.

items.title: Live-coded music set
items.description: Space for a CS Foundations project: a Strudel track, an Arduino build, or a first website.
